rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: With waw, the following noun may be an object of accompaniment or an object; the waw leaves the sense intact while the preceding governor assigns its case, as the examples and poetry show.
rows.anchor: فالفصيل مفعول معه والأب كذلك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In ما زلت وزيدا the second noun is an object, paraphrasable as ما زلت بزيد; by contrast, ما زلت أسير والنيل means travelling with the Nile.
rows.anchor: حتى فعل أى ما زلت بزيد حتى فعل فهو مفعول به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Do not coordinate a noun with an implicit nominative pronoun in a command such as اقعد وأخوك; make the pronoun explicit first.
rows.anchor: الاسم ليس على الفعل فى صنعت أنك لو قلت اقعد وأخوك كان قبيحا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Once the subject pronoun is explicit, the second element may follow either the first element's grammatical form or its meaning.
rows.anchor: فأنت بالخيار إن شئت حملت الآخر على ما حملت عليه الأول

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In ما شأنك وزيدا, attachment to the hidden pronoun is awkward and attachment to الشأن is ambiguous, so the construction is analyzed through an implied verb: ما شأنك وتناولك زيدا.
rows.anchor: لأن الشأن ليس يلتبس بعبد الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When the first name is overt, the following coordinated name can be genitive, as in the reported Arab examples ما شأن عبد الله وأخيه and ما شأن قيس والبر.
rows.anchor: فإذا أظهر الاسم فقال ما شأن عبد الله وأخيه يشتمه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: With ما أنت وزيد, nominative is more frequent and better; with ما شأن عبد الله وزيد, genitive is better because both are understood under شأن.
rows.anchor: والرفع أجود وأكثر فى ما أنت وزيد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The accusative in ما لزيد وأخاه can be understood through an omitted كان شأن construction, which supplies the verbal relation.
rows.anchor: قال ما لزيد وأخاه كأنه قال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: حسبك وزيدا permits the accusative because حسبك means كفاك; speakers supply an implicit verb rather than attach the noun to the hidden pronoun.
rows.anchor: لما كان فيه معنى كفاك وقبح أن يحملوه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In ويلا له وأخاه and ويله وأباه, the accusative is licensed by the understood verb ألزمه الله, even though the verb is not stated.
rows.anchor: فانتصب على معنى الفعل الذى نصبه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: هذا لك وأباك cannot take an accusative second noun because the expression contains neither a verb nor a particle with verbal force.
rows.anchor: فعلا ولا حرفا فيه معنى فعل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: An adjective following an indefinite noun takes its case and forms a semantic unit with it; the qualification narrows the referent to the subset sharing that description.
rows.anchor: مجرورا مثل المنعوت لأنهما كالاسم الواحد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Expressions such as أيما رجل qualify an indefinite by completeness; حسبك من رجل and similar forms describe one who is fully sufficient or adequate.
rows.anchor: فأيما نعت للرجل فى كماله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: مثلك can qualify an indefinite by likeness or equality, including likeness of appearance; similar forms such as ضربك and نحوك work alike.
rows.anchor: مررت برجل مثلك أى صورته شبيهة بصورتك

rows.speaker: يونس
rows.claim: Yunus treats هذا مثلك as definite when مثلك precedes the name and as indefinite when it follows; Sibawayh says some Arabs agree.
rows.anchor: ويونس يقول هذا مثلك مقبلا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: شر منك marks a lesser degree than the comparison point, while خير منك marks a greater degree.
rows.anchor: فهو نعت على أنه نقص أن يكون مثله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: غيرك distinguishes the described person from the one added after غير; آخر likewise marks another or separate individual.
rows.anchor: فغيرك نعت يفصل به بين من نعته بغير

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: حسن الوجه describes the indefinite through the quality of its own face, without the pronoun suffix found in حسن وجهه; the genitive phrase itself is adjectival.
rows.anchor: ومثل ذلك مررت بامرأة حسن الوجه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Sibawayh cites هذا عارض ممطرنا as an adjective phrase in which the active participle governs its complement while the phrase qualifies an indefinite.
rows.anchor: فالرفع ههنا كالجر فى باب الجر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A construct phrase attached to a definite noun can still function as an indefinite adjective when modifying, predicating, or naming an indefinite.
rows.anchor: فإنه إذا كان موصوفا أو وصفا أو خبرا

rows.speaker: يونس والخليل
rows.claim: Yunus and al-Khalil allow these construct adjectives to become definite in some contexts, as in ضاربك used like صاحبك.
rows.anchor: هذه الصفات المضافة إلى المعرفة التى صارت صفة للنكرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: حسن الوجه is an exception: it remains indefinite unless marked with the definite article, as in هذا الحسن الوجه.
rows.anchor: إلا حسن الوجه فإن بمنزلة رجل لا يكون معرفة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: إما قائم وإما قاعد says the person is in one of two states while leaving which state uncertain and excluding a third state such as reclining.
rows.anchor: فقد أعلمهم أنه ليس بمضطجع ولكنه شك فى القيام والقعود

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: With two predicates, و does not itself order the actions; ف marks the second as immediately following, whereas ثم marks a later action after an interval.
rows.anchor: مررت برجل راكب ثم ذاهب فبين أن الذهاب بعده

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: أو ساجد offers one of two alternatives like إما, while لا ساجد removes doubt or emphasizes certainty and بل ساجد corrects a slip or mistaken first description.
rows.anchor: فقد يجوز أن يقتصر عليه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: حسن الوجه جميلة is possible because حسن describes the particular face and جميل describes that same special attribute; a general quality would instead use matching general adjectives.
rows.anchor: والوجه ونحوه خاص ولو كان حسن العامة لقال حسن جميل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: رجل صدق means a sound or righteous man and رجل سوء a corrupt man; neither phrase refers to truthfulness of speech or to having caused harm.
rows.anchor: تقول هذا ثوب صدق وحمار صدق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: رجلين مثلين means each man resembles the other; رجلين مثلك can mean each resembles you or that the pair together resembles you.
rows.anchor: تفسير المثلين أن كل واحد منهما مثل صاحبه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When one noun is split between contrasting qualities, as in رجلين مسلم وكافر, the modifiers can be parsed as adjectives, badals, or nominative answers depending on the implied question.
rows.anchor: جمعت الاسم وفرقت النعت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In قد كان لكم آية في فئتين التقتا فئة تقاتل وأخرى كافرة, the later phrases can be genitive either as adjectives or as badal; the passage also permits an independent nominative analysis.
rows.anchor: قد كان لكم آية في فئتين التقتا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: رجل راكع وساجد describes one person with both predicates, unlike مسلم وكافر after two people, which divides the qualities across the individuals.
rows.anchor: من قبل أنك تبعض كأنك

rows.speaker: يونس
rows.claim: Yunus says مررت برجل مسلم وثلاثة رجال مسلمين takes genitive only because the noun and its adjective form one unit; raising would wrongly suggest a divided predicate.
rows.anchor: لأنك جعلت الكلام اسما واحدا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: With several different head nouns and one plural adjective, as in رجل وامرأة وحمار قيام, the adjective groups the nouns together; a divided reading would change the syntax.
rows.anchor: مررت برجل وامرأة وحمار قيام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In مررت بأربعة صريع وجريح, the adjectives describe portions of the group, meaning some are slain and some wounded; they may also be parsed as apposition or a fresh explanation.
rows.anchor: وتقول مررت بأربعة صريع وجريح

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: مثل رجلين can measure the described man by song or portion, while مثل رجل أسدا means lion-like in strength and courage; Sibawayh calls the latter weak and inelegant.
rows.anchor: مررت برجل مثل رجلين وذلك فى الغناء والجزء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A second adjective after بل can replace the first as a correction; لكن can make this repair after negation, but not after an affirmative clause.
rows.anchor: لأن لكن لا يتدارك بها بعد إيجاب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Sibawayh analyzes عباد مكرمون as nominative after the accusative ولدا, parallel to raising after a genitive; he also allows a genitive analysis as badal governed by the bāʾ.
rows.anchor: فالرفع ههنا بعد النصب كالرفع بعد الجر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: بل, ولا بل, and لكن can link two adjectives under one noun, like و, ف, ثم, أو, ولا, and إما.
rows.anchor: فيجريان على المنعوت كما أشركت بينهما

rows.speaker: يونس
rows.claim: Yunus rejects genitive after فكيف in ما مررت برجل مسلم فكيف رجل راغب, since كيف begins a new construction and has no omitted noun after it.
rows.anchor: زعم يونس أن الجر خطأ

rows.speaker: الخليل
rows.claim: For هذا جحر ضب خرب, most and best Arabic uses nominative because خرب modifies جحر; some use genitive, explained either by treating the phrase as one unit or by attraction to the preceding genitive.
rows.anchor: الرفع وهو كلام أكثر العرب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-Khalil explains that dual جحرا ضب خربان avoids confusing the adjective with the possessor; Sibawayh sees the two explanations as equally valid, with number and gender sometimes causing mistaken agreement.
rows.anchor: كل واحد منهما عنده وجها من التفسير
